title: Finite-Gap Solutions of the Pohlmeyer--Lund--Regge Equation and the Associated Lund-Regge Surfaces
summary: We develop a finite-gap construction for the Pohlmeyer-Lund-Regge (PLR) equation and the associated Lund-Regge surfaces. From the hyperelliptic spectral data we build a Baker-Akhiezer function and an SU(2)-frame, yielding an explicit theta-quotient formula for the PLR solution. We then derive criteria for s-periodicity and t-periodicity: under the stated theta-period assumptions, s-periodicity and t-periodicity are each equivalent to a critical-point condition for the corresponding normalized differential together with a phase condition at the reconstruction point.
